 Jio Financial Services Reports Q2 FY27 Consolidated Net Profit of ₹340.44 Crore, Revenue Operations Stand at ₹1,699.28 Crore
 16 Oct 2026, 10:09 AM IST 
 Equity Bulls 
 Stock Report Jio Financial Services Limited INE758E01017 
 Jio Financial Services Limited (NSE: JIOFIN, BSE: 543940) has announced its unaudited consolidated and standalone financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026 (Q2 FY27). The financial services arm of Reliance Industries recorded strong revenue growth across core lending and fee-based segments.
 Consolidated Financial Performance 
On a consolidated basis, Jio Financial Services reported revenue from operations of ₹1,699.28 crore for Q2 FY27. This represents a 73.15% year-on-year increase compared to ₹981.39 crore in Q2 FY26, and a sequential decline from ₹2,004.47 crore in Q1 FY27. Total consolidated income for the quarter stood at ₹1,699.41 crore, taking into account other income of ₹0.13 crore.
Key operational revenue drivers on a consolidated basis for Q2 FY27 included:
Interest Income: ₹1,257.68 crore, up 220.53% YoY from ₹392.37 crore in Q2 FY26 and up 30.79% QoQ from ₹961.58 crore.
Fees, Commission and Other Services: ₹277.09 crore, compared to ₹139.84 crore in Q2 FY26 and ₹324.54 crore in Q1 FY27.
Net Gain on Fair Value Changes: ₹164.51 crore.
Total consolidated expenses for Q2 FY27 were ₹1,166.07 crore, up from ₹436.50 crore in Q2 FY26 and ₹1,015.81 crore in Q1 FY27. Expenditure details included:
Finance Costs: ₹577.73 crore, compared to ₹135.82 crore in Q2 FY26 and ₹418.33 crore in Q1 FY27.
Other Expenses: ₹389.61 crore.
Employee Benefits Expense: ₹146.67 crore.
Impairment on Financial Instruments: ₹40.75 crore.
Depreciation and Amortisation Expense: ₹11.31 crore.
Consolidated profit before share of loss/profit in associates and joint ventures stood at ₹533.34 crore. After accounting for a share of loss in associates and joint ventures of ₹43.88 crore, profit before tax reached ₹489.46 crore.
Consolidated net profit after tax (PAT) for Q2 FY27 stood at ₹340.44 crore, compared to ₹695.04 crore in Q2 FY26 and ₹830.25 crore in Q1 FY27. Total tax expense for the quarter stood at ₹149.02 crore.
For the half-year ended September 30, 2026 (H1 FY27), consolidated revenue from operations surged 132.38% YoY to ₹3,703.75 crore, compared to ₹1,593.85 crore in H1 FY26. Consolidated net profit for H1 FY27 reached ₹1,170.69 crore, up 14.81% YoY from ₹1,019.70 crore in H1 FY26. Consolidated basic and diluted EPS for Q2 FY27 stood at ₹0.51 per share of face value ₹10 each, and ₹1.78 for H1 FY27.
 Standalone Financial Results 
On a standalone basis, Jio Financial Services generated revenue from operations of ₹677.72 crore for Q2 FY27, up 30.21% YoY from ₹520.49 crore in Q2 FY26 and up 209.41% QoQ from ₹219.04 crore in Q1 FY27. Dividend income contributed ₹445.13 crore, interest income contributed ₹153.97 crore, net gains on fair value changes stood at ₹77.72 crore, and fee/commission income added ₹0.90 crore.
Total standalone expenses for the quarter stood at ₹62.28 crore, comprising employee benefits expense of ₹25.38 crore, other expenses of ₹30.70 crore, impairment charges of ₹3.70 crore, and depreciation of ₹2.50 crore.
Standalone profit before tax for Q2 FY27 reached ₹615.44 crore, up 29.62% YoY from ₹474.82 crore in Q2 FY26 and up 327.57% QoQ from ₹143.94 crore in Q1 FY27. Standalone net profit after tax reached ₹575.34 crore, up 26.05% YoY from ₹456.45 crore in Q2 FY26 and up 446.69% QoQ from ₹105.24 crore in Q1 FY27. Total comprehensive income for the standalone entity stood at ₹569.47 crore.
For H1 FY27, standalone revenue from operations reached ₹896.76 crore, compared to ₹654.77 crore in H1 FY26. Standalone net profit for H1 FY27 reached ₹680.58 crore, compared to ₹527.91 crore in H1 FY26. Standalone basic and diluted EPS for Q2 FY27 stood at ₹0.87.
 Capital Base and Share Capital 
As of September 30, 2026, the paid-up equity share capital of Jio Financial Services Limited stood at ₹6,603.14 crore, consisting of equity shares with a face value of ₹10 each.
Other equity excluding revaluation reserves as of March 31, 2026, stood at ₹127,500.45 crore on a consolidated basis and ₹22,952.34 crore on a standalone basis.
Hitesh Sethia, Managing Director and CEO, Jio Financial Services, said: "Q2 FY27 marked yet another quarter of strong operational growth across our financial services platform. Our strategic playbook is now visibly taking shape with key global partnerships established across our core pillars-lending with Bank of America, investments with BlackRock, and insurance with Allianz Group. These marquee JVs bring world-class capabilities, institutional track records, and global best practices to India, while we drive growth on our digital platform and customer engagement ecosystem.
Innovations on the JioFinance app like JioFinance+ and JioFinance360 are central to our vision of becoming a proactive finance advisor for the people of India-ensuring their long-term financial health while lowering transaction costs by passing on a portion of platform commissions directly to users. As we look ahead, we continue to invest for growth to incubate nascent ventures while deploying support capital for businesses that are actively in their scale-up phase."
Shares of Jio Financial Services Limited was last trading in BSE at Rs. 218.75 as compared to the previous close of Rs. 218.55. The total number of shares traded during the day was 732102 in over 7537 trades.
The stock hit an intraday high of Rs. 221.40 and intraday low of 217.50. The net turnover during the day was Rs. 160738936.00.
